x2c is not currently accepting external code contributions, as described in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/gwf/x2c/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Unsolicited pull requests may be closed without review. To report a defect,
open a bug report issue instead; security reports follow
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/gwf/x2c/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
